name: @keyhole/app
description: Keyhole renderer — the UI the desktop app ships and the extension shares
//scripts: No `preview`/`start`: this workspace is not served to browsers as a product. `dev` is for developing the renderer; `build` produces what desktop/scripts/stage.mjs copies into the Electron package.

scripts.//test: No unit tests here by design: the logic lives in @keyhole/core (175 tests) and this workspace is React glue. Present so `npm test` at the root does not abort — npm 11 fails the whole run on a missing script even with --if-present.
scripts.test: node -e "console.log('@keyhole/app: no unit tests (logic is tested in @keyhole/core)')"
